revision_reason: The project designates the independently generated A1 1 h noise realization as the current official focused-series input. The previous A1 1 h realization is retained as a sensitivity comparison.
selection_caveat: This designation followed inspection of both retrieval posteriors; it is a post hoc project choice, not a pre-registered seed selection.
units: Fp in W m^-2 m^-1; sigma_Fp in W m^-2 m^-1
generation_method: Noise-free forward flux with validated scaled LIFEsim-classic diagonal sigma and one independent standard-normal draw per bin.
